import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
const directory = '/tmp/a03-fields-validation';
const read = name => JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${directory}/${name}.json`));
const proof = read('source-proof');
assert.deepEqual(proof.sourceBefore, proof.sourceAfter);
const controls = {};
const capabilities = {};
let rawSamples = 0;
for (const mode of ['numeric', 'fields']) {
  const before = read(`baseline-${mode}-performance`);
  const after = read(`candidate-${mode}-performance`);
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(before.results)) {
    const next = after.results[name];
    assert.equal(next.fixtureSHA256, value.fixtureSHA256);
    assert.equal(next.expected, value.expected);
    assert.equal(value.samples.length, 12);
    assert.equal(next.samples.length, 12);
    rawSamples += 24;
    const change = key => ({ before: value[key], after: next[key], difference: next[key] - value[key],
      percent: (next[key] / value[key] - 1) * 100 });
    controls[name] = { iterations: value.iterations, medianMs: change('medianMs'), p95Ms: change('p95Ms') };
  }
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(after.results)) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(before.results, name)) continue;
    assert.equal(value.expected, 'verified');
    assert.equal(value.samples.length, 12);
    rawSamples += 12;
    capabilities[name] = { iterations: value.iterations, medianMs: value.medianMs, p95Ms: value.p95Ms,
      note: 'Added capability; no baseline supported operation or timing comparison.' };
  }
}
assert.equal(rawSamples, 120);
const native = read('native');
const browsers = read('browser/report');
for (const observation of native.observations) assert.equal(observation.oracle.accepted, observation.expectedNative);
for (const engine of browsers.engines) assert.equal(engine.passed, true);
const summary = { candidateHead: proof.correctedCandidateHead ?? proof.candidateHead, baselineHead: proof.baselineHead, node: process.version,
  cpu: os.cpus()[0]?.model, os: os.release(), platform: os.platform(), architecture: os.arch(),
  controls, capabilities, rawSamples, samplesPerWorkload: 12, excludedWarmupSamples: 3,
  native: { count: native.observations.length, version: native.version,
    unsupported: native.observations.filter(value => value.policyStatus === 'unknown').map(value => value.name),
    differences: native.observations.filter(value => value.difference).map(value => value.name) },
  browsers: browsers.engines.map(value => ({ engine: value.engine, version: value.version, checks: value.checks.length })),
  retainedFirstAttempt: 'Expected-before baseline assertion succeeded on stderr; initial driver mistakenly checked stdout only.',
  measurementLimits: 'Shared host. Batch timings per 1000 calls, not individual percentiles. Heap deltas are neither allocations nor peak memory.' };
writeFileSync(`${directory}/summary.json`, JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log(JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
